manifest.publisher: Nirnaya Sagar Press, Bombay (1906), via archive.org
manifest.public_domain_basis: Own AI transcription of page images from Isadi-ashtavimshatyupanishadah, Nirnaya Sagar Press, Bombay, published 1906. The Pramana project owner accepts the public-domain basis for this edition: publication in 1906 establishes US public domain; editor Vasudeva Laxmana Shastri Pansikar is reported as 1863-1931 in one Google AI overview supplied by the owner, which would put the edition outside India's life-plus-60 term. The editor dates remain singly sourced; a second authority source is still wanted, and other contributors have not been confirmed. No modern edition's text or translation is used.
manifest.permission_proof: Approval recorded by the Pramana project owner in the publication task on 2026-10-16: the owner accepts the rights basis for the 1906 Nirnaya Sagar Isadi-ashtavimshatyupanishadah (archive.org item twentyeightupan00upangoog), including the reported editor dates 1863-1931 from one Google AI overview with second-source confirmation still wanted, and approves release of the AI transcription without human verse-by-verse review. See docs/upanishads-pilot/README.md and release-report-2026-10-16.md.
